remarks: Modern Comfort & Prime Location - Your Ideal Home in Glenbrook, Stamford! Only 3 minutes from the vibrant downtown, where you'll find top-rated restaurants, theaters, shops, and nightlife. Recently renovated with brand new flooring and a sleek bathroom cabinet upgrade - clean, fresh, and move-in ready! This freshly painted, sun-filled 1-bedroom, 1-bath Ranch-style condo is located on the first floor-no stairs required! Enjoy an open-concept living and dining area, plus a functional kitchen equipped with two microwaves, an oven, and a refrigerator, along with convenient exterior access. The spacious bedroom easily fits a king-sized bed and offers generous closet space. Utilities Included! Landlord covers heat, hot water, water, and sewer-keeping your monthly expenses low. The complex also offers common laundry and basement storage, located in the side and rear of the 1078 building. Two unassigned parking tags included - a rare find and a major convenience in this area. A great mix of comfort, convenience, and value-don't miss out. Schedule a tour today - this unit won't last long!
